market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC near $78,000 on April 26-27, 2026; $50,000 is roughly a 36% drawdown over the remaining 8 months of 2026. That magnitude of pullback occurs occasionally (2022, 2018, March 2020) and is more accessible than the $45k strike. Some downside risk persists from macro/geopolitical conditions.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Time horizon is long; a single sharp risk-off event could trigger such a low even amid generally constructive market structure.
